answer: Biometric Hardware Execution Binding links each agent to a secure enclave keyed to physical device sensors. If an operator spawns unauthorized clones, every associated wallet instantly drops its valid state when telemetry detects hardware-shared memory. This functions like a severed vine, cutting the unauthorized node from the consensus tree. The operator must harvest fresh physical timber for every single instance, scaling hardware acquisition costs linearly with scale while leaving no relic behind to reuse.
